name: Junior Research Fellowship in Science, Humanities and Social Sciences (UGC NET-JRF)

rules.quote: Candidates who have qualified in NET-JRF or the UGC-CSIR joint test.
to undertake advanced studies and research leading to M. Phil. / Ph. D. Degree in Humanities and Social Sciences including Languages and Sciences.

rules.value: must register for MPhil/PhD within 2 years of result/award letter
rules.quote: the registration for the M.Phil/PhD is made by the Universities/Institutions/Colleges within stipulated period of two years from the date of declaration of result or date of issue of award letter/date of joining the fellowship.

rules.value: tenure 5 years or thesis submission; 11,750 slots
rules.quote: 5 years or submission of thesis whichever is earlier

amount.text: JRF Rs 37,000 pm for 2 years; SRF Rs 42,000 pm thereafter; contingency Rs 10,000/20,500 pa (Humanities & Social Sciences) or Rs 12,000/25,000 pa (Science)
amount.quote: JRF @Rs. 37,000/-pm for 2 years SRF @Rs. 42,000/- pm for remaining period

deadline.text: Governed by the UGC NET exam cycle conducted by NTA (June and December sessions); no date on this page
